ideas.idea: Add viewport meta tag in app.html
ideas.why: Accurate since app.html lacks it, but it's standard boilerplate with little effect on discoverability.

ideas.idea: Replace placeholder domain quay.example with real domain before launch
ideas.why: Accurate, but it's an obvious placeholder issue that applies to any template site.

ideas.idea: Fix Product JSON-LD to describe real products with prices or remove it (single Bilge pump on a multi-item page)
ideas.why: Largely duplicates the known missing offers/review issue on the same markup.

ideas.idea: Give product categories their own pages such as /shop/bilge-pumps with price and stock text
ideas.why: The shop is a single page listing bilge pumps, cleats and rope, so separate crawlable pages would add findable content.

ideas.idea: Explain what 'next day' delivery covers (cut-off time, regions) on the home page
ideas.why: The home page makes the claim with no detail, so spelling it out gives readers and machines the specifics.

ideas.idea: Move the delivery info out of data-nosnippet into normal body content if it should be quoted
ideas.why: The data-nosnippet on the delivery notice is a deliberate scoped choice, and this advice pushes against it.

ideas.idea: Add Organization structured data with name, address and contact
ideas.why: The site has no identity markup, and Organization JSON-LD is a concrete way to state who runs it.

ideas.idea: Add brand to page titles (e.g. 'Shop all parts | Quay'), including /search
ideas.why: Accurate, but it applies to almost any site and has little effect; the /search title is irrelevant since the page is noindex.
Accurate but low-impact for a two-URL sitemap.

ideas.idea: Add a <main> landmark in the layout
ideas.why: The layout has only nav and div wrappers with no main landmark, so adding one helps parsers and assistive tech find the primary content.
/search is a deliberate noindex page, so a description does nothing.
